```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(stringr)
```

```{r load-data}
data_path <- here("prolific_data_2026-03-10.csv")
df <- read.csv(data_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```


```{r participant-breakdown}
cat("\n========== PARTICIPANT TRIAL BREAKDOWN ==========\n\n")

participant_trials <- df %>%
  group_by(prolific_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_trials = n(),
    n_stimulus_wheel = sum(trial_event == "stimulus_wheel_display_event"),
    n_orientation_response = sum(trial_event == "orientation_response_event"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_trials))

cat("Unique participants:", nrow(participant_trials), "\n\n")
cat("Participant ID | n_trials | stimulus_wheel | orientation_response\n")
cat(strrep("-", 75), "\n")

for (i in seq_len(nrow(participant_trials))) {
  row <- participant_trials[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("%-14s | %8d | %14d | %21d\n",
              row$prolific_id, row$n_trials, row$n_stimulus_wheel, row$n_orientation_response))
}

# --- Demographics (age, gender) for manuscript ---
# Survey rows use part = "age" / "gender" and response like {'age': '26'}.
# The trial-event-filtered prolific_data CSV omits those rows; fall back to full export if needed.
has_demo_rows <- "part" %in% names(df) &&
  any(df$part %in% c("age", "gender"), na.rm = TRUE)

resolve_demographics_data <- function() {
  if (has_demo_rows) return(df)
  candidates <- c(
    here("prolific_data_full_2026-03-10.csv"),
    here("CSVresults", "prolific_data_full_2026-03-10.csv"),
    here("..", "..", "..", "Experiments", "JSON Extraction", "CSVresults", "CSVresults_2026-03-10_.csv")
  )
  for (path in candidates) {
    if (file.exists(path)) {
      cat("\n(Loading demographics from full export:", path, ")\n")
      return(read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
  }
  NULL
}

extract_participant_demographics <- function(data) {
  if (is.null(data) || !"part" %in% names(data)) {
    return(tibble::tibble())
  }

  data %>%
    filter(part %in% c("age", "gender")) %>%
    mutate(
      value = str_extract(response, "(?<=': )['\"]?([^'\",}]+)"),
      subexperiment = suppressWarnings(as.integer(subexperiment))
    ) %>%
    select(prolific_id, subexperiment, part, value) %>%
    group_by(prolific_id, part) %>%
    summarise(
      value = dplyr::first(value),
      subexperiment = dplyr::first(subexperiment),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = part, values_from = value) %>%
    mutate(age = as.numeric(age))
}

print_age_summary <- function(ages, label) {
  ages <- ages[!is.na(ages)]
  if (length(ages) == 0) {
    cat(label, ": no age data\n")
    return(invisible(list(n = 0L, mean_age = NA_real_, sd_age = NA_real_, min_age = NA_real_, max_age = NA_real_)))
  }
  stats <- list(
    n = length(ages),
    mean_age = mean(ages),
    sd_age = stats::sd(ages),
    min_age = min(ages),
    max_age = max(ages)
  )
  cat(sprintf(
    "%s: N = %d, mean age = %.1f years, SD = %.1f, range = %.0f–%.0f\n",
    label, stats$n, stats$mean_age, stats$sd_age, stats$min_age, stats$max_age
  ))
  invisible(stats)
}

print_gender_table <- function(demo_df, label) {
  if (nrow(demo_df) == 0 || !"gender" %in% names(demo_df)) {
    cat(label, ": no gender data\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  cat("\n", label, ":\n", sep = "")
  print(table(demo_df$gender, useNA = "ifany"))
}

demo_source <- resolve_demographics_data()
participant_demographics <- extract_participant_demographics(demo_source)

cat("\n========== PARTICIPANT DEMOGRAPHICS (MANUSCRIPT) ==========\n\n")

if (nrow(participant_demographics) == 0) {
  cat("No age/gender rows found. Use a full Prolific export (rows with part = age/gender),\n")
  cat("or place prolific_data_full_2026-03-10.csv in this project folder.\n")
} else {
  age_stats_all <- print_age_summary(participant_demographics$age, "All participants")
  print_gender_table(participant_demographics, "All participants — gender")

  sub_labels <- c(
    "1" = "Subexperiment 1 (practice_effect)",
    "2" = "Subexperiment 2 (Context Effect Hypothesis)",
    "3" = "Subexperiment 3 (Multiple Features Effect Hypothesis)"
  )

  age_stats_by_sub <- list()
  for (sub in sort(unique(participant_demographics$subexperiment))) {
    sub_demo <- participant_demographics %>%
      filter(subexperiment == sub)
    label <- sub_labels[as.character(sub)]
    if (is.na(label)) label <- paste("Subexperiment", sub)
    age_stats_by_sub[[as.character(sub)]] <- print_age_summary(sub_demo$age, label)
    print_gender_table(sub_demo, paste0(label, " — gender"))
  }

  cat("\n--- Mean age at a glance (years) ---\n")
  cat(sprintf("  All participants: %.1f\n", age_stats_all$mean_age))
  for (sub in names(age_stats_by_sub)) {
    cat(sprintf("  Subexperiment %s: %.1f\n", sub, age_stats_by_sub[[sub]]$mean_age))
  }

  missing_demo <- participant_trials %>%
    anti_join(participant_demographics, by = "prolific_id")
  if (nrow(missing_demo) > 0) {
    cat("\nParticipants with trials but no age/gender row:", nrow(missing_demo), "\n")
  }
}
```

```{r summary-stats}
cat("Min trials:", min(participant_trials$n_trials), "\n")
cat("Max trials:", max(participant_trials$n_trials), "\n")
```

## Processing chunks (one thing at a time)

```{r subset-setup, include=FALSE}
key_cols <- c(
  "subexperiment", "participant_id", "redundancy", "tab_away_count",
  "target_orientation", "started_outof_center", "too_fast_trigger", "num_items",
  "response_RT_from_start", "response_error_deg", "duration_ms",
  "response_orientation_360", "response_RT", "leave_center_RT", "cue_type",
  "too_slow_trigger", "trial_event", "trial_number"
)

subset_output_dir <- here("CSVresults", "subexperiment_keycols")
dir.create(subset_output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

make_participant_id <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      participant_id = dplyr::coalesce(
        na_if(as.character(prolific_id), ""),
        na_if(as.character(subject_id), ""),
        na_if(as.character(uid), "")
      )
    )
}

reindex_participants <- function(data) {
  unique_ids <- sort(unique(data$participant_id))
  lookup <- tibble::tibble(
    original_id = unique_ids,
    participant_id_new = sprintf("%02d", seq_along(unique_ids))
  )

  data_reindexed <- data %>%
    left_join(lookup, by = c("participant_id" = "original_id")) %>%
    mutate(participant_id = dplyr::coalesce(participant_id_new, participant_id)) %>%
    select(-participant_id_new)

  list(
    data = data_reindexed,
    lookup = lookup %>% rename(participant_id = participant_id_new)
  )
}
```

```{r chunk1-extract-subsets}
# sub1 = subexperiment 1 (practice_effect)
# sub2 = subexperiment 2 (Context Effect Hypothesis)
# sub3 = subexperiment 3 (Multiple Features Effect Hypothesis)

sub1 <- df %>%
  filter(subexperiment == 1, experiment_type == "practice_effect") %>%
  make_participant_id() %>%
  select(any_of(key_cols))
sub2 <- df %>%
  filter(subexperiment == 2, experiment_type == "Context Effect Hypothesis") %>%
  make_participant_id() %>%
  select(any_of(key_cols))
sub3 <- df %>%
  filter(subexperiment == 3, experiment_type == "Multiple Features Effect Hypothesis") %>%
  make_participant_id() %>%
  select(any_of(key_cols))

sub1_reindexed <- reindex_participants(sub1)
sub2_reindexed <- reindex_participants(sub2)
sub3_reindexed <- reindex_participants(sub3)

sub1 <- sub1_reindexed$data
sub2 <- sub2_reindexed$data
sub3 <- sub3_reindexed$data

subset_paths <- list(
  sub1 = file.path(subset_output_dir, "sub1_key_cols.csv"),
  sub2 = file.path(subset_output_dir, "sub2_key_cols.csv"),
  sub3 = file.path(subset_output_dir, "sub3_key_cols.csv")
)

participant_id_record <- bind_rows(
  mutate(sub1_reindexed$lookup, subset = "sub1"),
  mutate(sub2_reindexed$lookup, subset = "sub2"),
  mutate(sub3_reindexed$lookup, subset = "sub3")
)
participant_lookup_path <- file.path(subset_output_dir, "participant_id_lookup.csv")

cat("\n========== CHUNK 1: SUBSETS BY SUBEXPERIMENT ==========\n")
cat("sub1 (practice_effect):            ", nrow(sub1), " rows, ", dplyr::n_distinct(sub1$participant_id), " participants\n", sep = "")
cat("sub2 (Context Effect Hypothesis): ", nrow(sub2), " rows, ", dplyr::n_distinct(sub2$participant_id), " participants\n", sep = "")
cat("sub3 (Multiple Features Effect):  ", nrow(sub3), " rows, ", dplyr::n_distinct(sub3$participant_id), " participants\n", sep = "")
write.csv(sub1, subset_paths$sub1, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved sub1 key columns subset to", subset_paths$sub1, "\n")
write.csv(sub2, subset_paths$sub2, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved sub2 key columns subset to", subset_paths$sub2, "\n")
write.csv(sub3, subset_paths$sub3, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved sub3 key columns subset to", subset_paths$sub3, "\n")
write.csv(participant_id_record, participant_lookup_path, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved participant ID mapping to", participant_lookup_path, "\n")
```
